hits.title: Minimarket 67/7: Store Tycoon
hits.description:
Become the manager of your own minimarket and turn a small store into a profitable retail business! Stock your shelves, hire employees, upgrade equipment, and expand your store. Serve customers, improve service speed, and make sure your visitors stay happy.

Automate your workflows, develop your store, and increase your profits. Every upgrade helps you serve more customers, earn more money, and unlock new opportunities to grow your business.

Game Features:
• Manage your minimarket and staff
• Stock products and develop your store
• Upgrade employees and equipment
• Increase service speed and profits
• Gradually expand your store
• Simple and intuitive management
• Unlock new opportunities as you progress
• No complicated rules — perfect for relaxing

Can you turn a small minimarket into a successful retail empire and become a true store tycoon?
hits.howToPlayText:
Controls:
• On mobile devices, move the joystick at the bottom of the screen to control your character.
• On PC, use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to move.

hits.title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
hits.description: Embark on a journey to become a retail mogul with Idle Supermarket Tycoon. This engaging online simulation game lets you transform a modest shopping mall into a bustling retail empire. Strategically develop new shops, enhance their interiors, and beautify the mall's exterior. Your mission: serve customers, boost your reputation, and watch your profits soar. Play for free on your phone or computer and experience the thrill of managing your own supermarket kingdom
hits.howToPlayText:
You have a Shopping mall at your disposal, which you need to develop by acquiring new shops and outfitting them, as well as improving the exterior and interior of the entire Shopping mall.

Serve customers, earn money and reputation. Invest your profits into your Shopping mall, and distribute reputation points among visitors. Assign priority customers to each shop in your mall. This way, you can maximize profits from serving them!

Purchase delivery vehicles to earn additional income from each completed trip. Don't forget to monitor the corridors, as trash cans or vending machines might get clogged.

If you're unsure what to do next, you can always refer to the missions. Complete them to earn valuable rewards and expand your Shopping mall, your grand Supermarket!



Controls:
Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI
Plus and minus keys = change the size of the camera

hits.title: Supermarket Manager
hits.description:
Try your hand as a Supermarket Manager! Develop your store by purchasing shelves for products, which you will need to stock yourself at the beginning. Earn profits by serving customers and invest your earnings to hire staff like stockers and cashiers.
Boost the prestige of your supermarket by improving the quality of the products you sell. Then, invest in more expensive shelves and fill them with a wider variety of goods. Start earning maximum profits from serving each customer and build the supermarket of your dreams!
hits.howToPlayText:
For PC Controls = Use the left mouse button or the WASD keys to move your character
For Smartphone Controls = Hold your finger on the screen and drag it in the direction you want the character to move
To purchase a shelf or a cash register, stand on the corresponding areas marked on the game field
To stock shelves with products, first load products from the warehouse, then carry them to the appropriate shelf
In the warehouse area, you'll find a computer. Approaching it will open the store management menu. Here, you can improve product quality or hire staff

Agrarian Magnate is a farming business simulator. The farm, processing, and store are all in your hands. Build your business empire!
Complete levels, complete tasks and earn money. Manage your farm, factory and store. Hire salespeople, upgrade your equipment, and take your business to the next level.Buy and earn daily bonuses. Bonuses are given for one round.

Mobile: tap to select. On the farm, level selection, and factory, drag the field with your finger.

hits.title: HoleMart
hits.description:
HoleMart is a fun and addictive casual game where you control a growing hole inside a busy market.
Move around the area, swallow objects, and expand your size as you consume more items.

Start small by absorbing tiny goods, shelves, and carts. As your hole grows bigger, you’ll be able to swallow larger objects and clear the market faster. The more you consume, the stronger and bigger your hole becomes.

Simple controls, satisfying growth, and smooth gameplay make HoleMart perfect for quick play sessions and endless fun.
hits.howToPlayText:
Move the Hole
Drag your finger to move the hole around the market.

Consume Objects
Absorb smaller objects to increase your size.

Grow Bigger
The more items you swallow, the larger your hole becomes.

Unlock Larger Items
As you grow, you can consume bigger shelves, carts, and objects.

Clear the Market
Keep swallowing until the market is completely cleared.
